title: Dictators outlawed Freemasonry

tellings.quote: that's one of the Hitler did it, Mao did it, Stalin did it. They outlawed Freemasonry.

plain: A researcher named Randall Carlson, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that Hitler, Mao and Stalin all outlawed Freemasonry, the old fraternal society that meets in lodges. He tells it as a shared trait of those dictators, suggesting that the society was seen as a threat by men who wanted total control.
